verdict: B BOUNDED -- no detectable difference, any form effect under 0.026. Entry 162 closed r85 by naming what it did not cover: a null in ONE quantity, while the ten form-sliced rounds measure several. This takes the one that matters -- OWN-minus-DONOR attribution, the source-specificity contrast the package is about. Over 968 prompts of the full join, scored against real human rankings with r12's donor permutation: attribution is +0.1258 [+0.1038,+0.1483] on the 293 long-form prompts and +0.1202 [+0.1056,+0.1351] on the 675 short-form ones, against +0.1215 on the whole join. The gap is +0.0056 [-0.0209,+0.0310], inside a form-label shuffle null of [-0.0260,+0.0270]. THE ANSWERABLE MARGIN IS 0.0260, limited by 293 long-form prompts, so this settles equivalence at delta=0.026 and not at 0.01. WHAT IT MEANS FOR THE TEN SLICED ROUNDS: source specificity is positive in BOTH forms, and any form-associated difference in it is under 0.026. So entry 161's scope block describes where those rounds were measured without implying their central contrast is peculiar to it. CONFOUND, unchanged and not weakened by repetition: the forms cover disjoint prompts, so this compares questions as well as instruments. It bounds a difference and cannot attribute one. DONORS are drawn from the whole join, not within form -- restricting them would confound the donor arm with the split under test.
